title: Maria's Weekend
text:
Maria likes music. On Saturdays, she plays the guitar in her room. Her brother plays the drums with her. They play for one hour.

On Sundays, Maria goes to the park with her dog. The dog is brown and very fast. They run and play with a ball. Maria is happy when she is outside.

questions.text: What does Maria play on Saturdays?
Why does Maria probably like the weekend?
options: Because she can do things she enjoys
Because she must go to school
Because she does not like music

questions.text: Why are Maria and her brother probably good friends?
options: They do not like the same things.

vocabulary.definition: a musical instrument with strings that you play with your fingers
a public place with grass and trees where people can relax

paragraph_translations: A María le gusta la música. Los sábados, toca la guitarra en su habitación. Su hermano toca la batería con ella. Tocan durante una hora.
Los domingos, María va al parque con su perro. El perro es marrón y muy rápido. Corren y juegan con una pelota. María está feliz cuando está al aire libre.
